servicesLabel: What I bring to the table
servicesTitle: I figure out what needs to be said before deciding how it should look.
servicesIntro: I start by understanding the business, the people behind it and the people it needs to reach. From there, we build the brand and website around what actually makes you worth choosing.
services: Positioning, messaging and visual direction that give the business a clearer identity — without trying to sound bigger, smarter or different than it really is.
Structure, UX, design and development brought together from the start. The result is a website that feels good to use and makes it easy to understand where to go next.
The words and images should feel like they belong to the same business as the design. I can take care of both, so the final result feels consistent rather than assembled from separate pieces.
Launching isn’t where the relationship has to end. I can stay involved, see how the site performs and improve it as the business changes.
methodTitle: Understand the business first. Design the right thing second.
method: Turn the idea into something real
aboutTitle: I’m Jonas. Designer, developer and occasional photographer.
aboutText: I work directly with founders and small teams who care about what they’re building. Keeping strategy, design, development and photography close together means fewer handovers, fewer things getting lost in translation, and a result that feels like one idea from start to finish.
photosTitle: Photography keeps me curious about places, people and details.
contactTitle: Feel like your business has outgrown its website?
contactText: Tell me what you’re working on, what isn’t working, or simply where you want to take the business next.
